notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Explore Fresh Features with New Leaf Farm Patch 1.0.3!

Hello, New Leaf Farmers! 🌟

We're excited to roll out version 1.0.3 of New Leaf Farm, packed with new content, enhancements, and fixes to enrich your farming adventure. This update brings new quests, customization options, and much more! Here’s what you can look forward to:

🌱 New Features and Content 🌱

New Game Intro: Experience a brand-new introduction when you start new game sessions, setting the stage for your farming journey.

Island History Expansion: Dive deeper into the lore of the island with more history to explore, enriching your connection to the game world.

New Quests and Mysteries: Embark on fresh quests and uncover new Mystery Points of Interest (POIs) scattered across the island.

Revamped Store Appearances: Stores have received a visual overhaul, enhancing your shopping experience.

Customization:

Paint Customization for Fences and Vehicles: Personalize your farm's look with customizable paint options for fences and vehicles.
Farm Sign with Paint Customization: Mark your territory with a customizable Farm Sign, which you can paint to match your farm's theme.

🔧 Enhancements and Fixes 🔧

Bug and Network Fixes: We’ve ironed out various bugs and network issues to ensure smoother gameplay.

Economic Rebalance: The costs of furniture and farm items have been rebalanced, ensuring a fair and enjoyable economic system.

Improved Pet-Taming: The pet-taming process now allows multiple attempts, making it easier to befriend your favorite animals.

Enhanced Store Interfaces:

Details Window in Stores: Get more information on items with a new details window, helping you make informed purchases.

Swap Action in Warehouse: Organize your warehouse more efficiently with the new 'Swap' action.
Interface Improvements: Updates to the storage menu and store inputs enhance usability and interaction.

We hope you enjoy these updates as much as we enjoyed creating them. As always, we are committed to improving New Leaf Farm and deeply value your feedback.

Happy farming, and see you on the island! 🌾🚜

❤️ P.S.: If you love the updates, please consider leaving a review on Steam—it helps us a lot and keeps the updates coming!

notes.title: Patch 1.02.51 Steamdeck
notes.notes:
🌟 New Leaf UPDATE 1.02.51🌟

We're rolling out a quick hotfix to address some specific issues and make your farming experience even smoother, especially for our Steam Deck users. Here’s a brief overview of what this hotfix includes:

🔧 Performance and Compatibility Fixes for Steamdeck 🔧

Keyboard Input Correction:  Fixed an issue related to keyboard inputs when naming your character. This fix ensures a seamless and error-free input process across different devices.

Steam Deck Optimization:  We've implemented fixes to enhance performance specifically for the Steam Deck. These improvements aim to provide a smoother and more stable gameplay experience on this popular portable platform.

🌟 Gameplay Adjustment 🌟

Stamina from Tamed Animals:  We've adjusted the amount of stamina you gain from tamed animals to better balance the gameplay and make your interactions with farm animals more rewarding.

Happy farming, and see you in New Leaf Farm! 🌾

notes.title: Patch 1.02.5
notes.notes:
🌟 New Leaf UPDATE 1.02.5🌟

This update addresses several crucial issues and introduces exciting new gameplay elements. Here’s everything you need to know about the latest changes:

🌱 Gameplay Enhancements 🌱


 Efficient Irrigation: Sprinklers have been upgraded to water a 5x5 area, allowing for more effective and extensive coverage of your crops.

 Speedy Planting: The speed of planting seeds has been increased, making your farming quicker and more efficient.

 Animal Proximity: Reduced the distance animals can wander from base buildings, keeping your livestock closer to home.

 Pet Management: Added a new option at the pet house to select whether or not a pet follows you, giving you more control over your farming companion.

 Culinary Expansion: Introduced new cooked fish recipes for each type of fish, all unlocked by default. Get ready to enhance your culinary skills!

 Improved Interaction Detection: Changes have been made to how crops and objects are detected based on the camera's position. This update allows you to select objects all around more easily without needing to rotate your character—just the camera.

 Crop Status Visibility: Increased the distance at which crop status icons are shown. You can now check the status of your crops without having to be right next to them.


🛠️ Bug Fixes 🛠️


 Miner's Comfort: Fixed an issue where hair was clipping through helmets in the mines. Now you can mine in style and safety!

 NPC Visibility: Resolved a problem where quest NPCs could sometimes become invisible, ensuring they're always available when you need them.

 Charging Station Stability: Fixed a bug with the placement and saving of Charging Stations, so they should now function reliably in your game.

 Pet Name Memory: Corrected an issue where pets' names weren't being saved properly.

  Inventory Duplication: Addressed a duplication bug in the inventory


We hope these updates make your farming life even more enjoyable and streamlined. As always, we appreciate your feedback and are constantly working to improve the game based on your insights.

Happy farming, and see you in New Leaf Farm! 🌾👨‍🌾👩‍🌾

❤️ P.S.: Loving the game? Please consider leaving a review on Steam to support us in making New Leaf even better!

notes.title: Patch 1.02.4
notes.notes:
🌟 New Leaf UPDATE 1.02.4🌟

We're back with another update to enhance your farming experience!


 🛠️ Bug Fixes and Adjustments 🛠️

 Left Mouse Key Interaction:  You can now interact with items as well with left mouse button

 Mail Item Request: Fixed a bug where a mail request vanished when loading an older game session due to date irregularities.

 Warehouse Missing Items: Addressed an issue where you could lose all your items in the warehouse when loading a game.

 Pet and Farm Animal: Resolved a bug where renaming a farm animal caused your pet’s name to change as well.

 Diamond: We've slightly altered the material appearance of the Diamond mineral to make it more distinguishable from Silver.

 Item Names: We've added names above most items in the game including trees, animals, mushrooms, and minerals. Now, when you approach an item, its name will appear above the interaction icon, making mining and gathering even easier.

 Fertilizer Machine: Fixed a bug where the menu would get stuck on the Fertilizer Machine interface.

 Loading Screens Save: Introduced a loading screen when saving your game and when returning to the main menu for a smoother transition.

 Crops Interaction: Names of crops will now appear over them , making it easier to manage your farm.

 NPC Updates: Improved the NPC quest markers to appear only when necessary, enhancing the clarity and focus of your quests.

 Plus, we've addressed other smaller bugs that you've mentioned to us through the Bugs channel.



🌞 What’s Next? 🌞

We continue to take all your advice and problems under consideration to make New Leaf a great experience for everyone. Every bit of feedback is welcomed.

Keep cool and happy farming! 🌾👩‍🌾👨‍🌾

❤️ P.S.: If you think the game is deserving, please consider leaving a review on Steam—it would really help us a lot! ❤️

notes.title: Patch 1.02.2
notes.notes:
We're rolling out another important update to address some critical issues that have been affecting older builds and some key game mechanics.

⚡ Electricity and Water Management Fixes ⚡

Electricity Stability: We've addressed an issue affecting electricity supply in older game builds.

Water Pump Calibration: We've resolved a problem where the water pump wasn't detecting sprinklers properly

🛠️ Quest and Mechanic Enhancements 🛠️

 We've been receiving some mixed feedback about our character portraits, so for now, we've decided to remove them.

 Lift Quest Correction: We've fixed the Lift quest to ensure it operates as intended. 

 Lift Operation in Riverlands: An issue was identified where the lift would not operate correctly if players saved their game in the Riverlands


 If you're enjoying our dedication and hard work we would like to ask leaving an honest review on steam.

 Keep sending us your feedback, and happy farming! 🌾

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
We're back with 1.02 update to enhance your farming adventure!  Here’s what’s new in our latest game patch!

🔋 Charging Station 🔋

Power Up!: We’ve added a new Charging Station located in the Village's Vehicle Dealership.

🌱 Sprinkler System Update 🌱

Optimized Irrigation: We've updated the craft requirements for both small and big sprinklers. 


🛠️ Bug Fixes and Adjustments 🛠️


 Mineral and Wood Adjustments: We've fine-tuned the percentages for mineral yields and Koa wood production, ensuring a more balanced and rewarding gathering experience.

 Energy Bug Squashed: Fixed an issue where manual saves incorrectly restored full energy levels.

 Stability Underfoot: Addressed a bug where characters could accidentally drop under the map, disrupting gameplay.

 Fishing Tool Mix-Up: Fixed a bug that allowed fishing with any tool, which could lead to unexpected gameplay experiences.

 Solar Panel Connectivity: Resolved an issue where solar panels could incorrectly connect with other items.

 Missing Items: Fixed a problem where items could disappear from storage, ensuring that all your stored goods are accounted for and safe.



🌞 What’s Next? 🌞
Steam Deck Support, Improve ingame Inputs and more

We're constantly listening to your feedback and making improvements. Keep those suggestions coming, and stay tuned for more updates that will make New Leaf Farm even better.

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. We can't wait for you to experience these improvements. Happy farming, and see you in the game! 🌾👩‍🌾👨‍🌾

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Hello, New Leaf Farmers! 🌱 Patch 1.01 is UP. 

First and foremost, a huge thank you to everyone who has supported our game and shared their feedback. Your insights, both positive and negative, have been invaluable in shaping this update. We're excited to share several game enhancements designed to enrich your farming experience. Let's dig into the details of what's new in the latest patch!

🛠️ Game Mechanics Updates 🛠️

 Stamina Overhaul: We've made some great adjustments to the stamina system! Now, harvesting crops will no longer reduce your stamina. Additionally, we've decreased the stamina required for other demanding tasks like mining and tree cutting. Farm away with less fatigue!

 Increased Mobility: Feel the need for speed? We've increased your character's running speed to help you navigate your farm quicker than ever.

 Smooth Actions: The timing between actions has been improved, allowing for a more fluid experience when performing repetitive tasks like chopping and mining.

 Pause and Plan: In solo mode, time will now pause whenever you are navigating any UI menu, giving you a moment to strategize without pressure.


🎨 Visual Improvements 🎨

 Natural Beauty: We've toned down the wind animations on trees and grass to create a more calming and less distracting environment.

 Sunny Days: The sun's position has been adjusted to accurately match the compass, enhancing the game's realism and immersion.


🖥️ UI Enhancements 🖥️

 Revamped Journal: The Journal window has been redesigned to clearly explain the benefits you gain with each level, including increased stamina and chances to perform actions without depleting stamina.

 Save Button: By popular demand, a save button has been added to the settings window for easier game progress management.

 Inventory Clarity: We've adjusted the grid texture in the inventory to enhance readability of item descriptions.

 Seed Insights: Seed descriptions now include growth times and clearer seasonal warnings, helping you plan your planting more effectively.

 Interaction Feedback: We've refined the outline effect when you double-click items to make it more distinct.


🔧 Bug Fixes 🔧

 Fishing Frustration Fixed: Resolved an issue where characters could get stuck while fishing with no stamina left.

 Level Up Lag: Fixed a bug that caused the game to hang during the level-up process.

 Bus Bug: Corrected a rare problem where the bus would get stuck outside the mines area.

 Shadow Adjustment: Fixed an unnatural shadow around the player's head.



🚧 Ongoing Improvements 🚧

We're not stopping here! Our team is actively working on further enhancements, including:

 Input Optimization: We're refining the input methods for keyboard, mouse, and controller.

 Minimap Development: A handy minimap is on its way to help you navigate your farm more easily.

 Animal Care Alerts: Soon, you'll receive notifications about your animals' feed status to ensure they're always happy and healthy.


We hope you enjoy these updates as much as we enjoyed developing them. Keep the feedback coming, and happy farming! 🌻🚜
